scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,web" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/poker-engine && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/poker-engine && npm run test -w apps/server
